fir.description: Deponent reports that 3 accused person(s) operated in concert at this ATM kiosk. The primary suspect entered and tampered with the card reader while two others maintained surveillance outside and coordinated via phone. A fourth individual reported suspicious conduct to the bank security officer shortly after the group departed. 2 independent witness(es) have filed statements.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: A male subject approaches the ATM from the eastern end of the street, scanning the area before moving toward the kiosk.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: I can see the ATM from here, it looks clear.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: Almost at the spot, stay on the line.

observations.location: ATM booth entrance, exterior door
observations.content: Second individual arrives at the ATM entrance and positions himself near the door, facing outward.

observations.location: ATM booth entrance, exterior door
observations.content: I'm at the door. No one else around, you're good to go.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: Primary subject pushes through the ATM booth door and enters the enclosure.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: Inside now, booth is empty.

observations.location: ATM booth entrance, exterior door
observations.content: Second suspect remains stationed outside the ATM booth, periodically checking both directions of the street.

observations.location: ATM booth entrance, exterior door
observations.content: All clear out here, take your time.

observations.location: ATM street junction, northern corner
observations.content: Security footage log note: third associate standing by near the ATM street junction, acting as a lookout.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: Subject is seen crouching at the card slot area and applying a flat device to the reader housing.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: Device attached. Looks factory. Moving to step two.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: Suspect conducts a test transaction using the ATM terminal after attaching the device.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: Transaction going through now.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: Primary suspect exits the ATM booth, pulling the door closed behind him.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: Done in here, moving now.

observations.location: ATM booth interior, card reader area
observations.content: Out now. Walk.

observations.location: ATM booth entrance, exterior door
observations.content: Both individuals are recorded walking away from the ATM side by side at a brisk pace.

observations.location: ATM booth entrance, exterior door
observations.content: Let's move, quick. Security vehicle two blocks down.

observations.location: ATM vicinity, bystander position south side
observations.content: Two men ran out of the ATM booth. One was carrying something flat under his jacket. Both walked very fast toward the junction.

observations.location: ATM vicinity, bystander position south side
observations.content: Saw a man rush out and walk away fast. Seemed nervous. Second person joined him immediately outside.

observations.location: ATM street frontage, wide-angle view
observations.content: A bystander is captured on wide-angle footage standing near the ATM entrance, watching the two men leave and immediately calling someone on her phone.

observations.location: ATM vicinity, bystander position south side
observations.content: I want to report a suspicious activity at the SBI ATM on 5th Block. Two men tampered with the machine I think.

observations.location: ATM vicinity, bystander position south side
observations.content: Filing complaint: saw someone tamper with the card slot at the ATM near Koramangala 5th Block. Happened around 2pm.
